distinguishing_features: Engineered heterogeneous nucleation sites (textured/seeded surfaces) on heat exchanger walls
Mechanism of controlled nucleation via surface engineering rather than process setpoint adjustment
Application to juice freeze concentration to prevent solute trapping
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to prevent uncontrolled ice nucleation and solute trapping in freeze concentration of juice
parsed.viable_reason: The mechanism is physically feasible because engineered nucleation sites on heat exchanger surfaces can lower the supercooling required for ice nucleation, and the proposed test protocol can validate it.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: The closest prior art addresses fouling in KCl crystallizers via temperature setpoint adjustment, which does not suggest using surface texturing to control nucleation in juice freeze concentration.
